paragraphs.source_en:
The
rain has held back for days and days, my God, in my arid heart. The horizon is fiercely naked—not the thinnest cover of a soft cloud, not the vaguest hint of a distant cool shower.

paragraphs.source_en: Send thy angry storm, dark with death, if it is thy wish, and with lashes of lightning startle the sky from end to end.

units.source_en: Send thy angry storm, dark with death, if it is thy wish, and with lashes of lightning startle the sky from end to end.

paragraphs.source_en: But call back, my lord, call back this pervading silent heat, still and keen and cruel, burning the heart with dire despair.
